title: Refunding a Marketplace Orders Replacement Charge When the Original Comes Back
content:
## Policy

When the original unit of a Marketplace Orders replacement comes back after its unreturned-replacement deadline (the replacement date recorded on the replacement entry plus the option's unreturned replacement days, in calendar days), the replacement charge collected on the order is refunded in part, as one replacement-charge refund booked by Northloop.

The replacement-charge refund is funded by Northloop, which collected the charge, and goes to the original payment method as an item refund tied to the return of the original unit; return refunds of the item price, cancellations, losses, fulfillment errors and granted claims keep their funding party unchanged.

A replacement and an item refund of the units' purchase price stay mutually exclusive for the same units; the replacement-charge refund pays back part of a charge collected for keeping those units and is the one item refund that may follow a replacement on them.

The replacement-charge refund withholds its own deductions whatever the reason of the return the replacement was shipped against; return refunds of the item price keep deductions only for reasons that are not seller-fault reasons.

The refund of a replacement charge is booked only after that charge stands captured on the order.

Restated in the same terms: as long as no replacement charge stands captured on the order, no refund of a replacement charge is booked.

### The refund at a glance

| Element | Replacement-charge refund |
|---|---|
| Occasion | the original unit comes back after its unreturned-replacement deadline |
| Booked by and funded by | Northloop, which collected the charge |
| Destination | the original payment method |
| Recorded as | one item refund tied to the return of the original unit |
| Relation to a refund of the purchase price | the purchase-price refund and the replacement stay mutually exclusive for the same units; this refund is the one item refund that may follow a replacement on them |

## Refund tool: `refund_replacement_charge_bf6a8eb8`

**Capability.** Refunds to the buyer, from Northloop, part or all of a replacement charge collected on one marketplace order, where the original unit of that replacement has come back. One call records one refund entry dated today on that order, tied to the return of the original unit, funded by Northloop and sent to the original payment method, and lowers the order's net amount paid by the amount refunded. The buyer sees the refund on the order's activity immediately.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `refund_replacement_charge_bf6a8eb8` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `order_id` | the marketplace order number the replacement charge was collected on, read from the order lookup | identifier |
| `return_id` | the return number of the original unit that came back, read from the order activity lookup | identifier |
| `refund_component` | which component of the order the refund entry covers | exactly one of `item` (pays back money collected for units of the item), `original_shipping` (pays back the shipping charged at checkout), `tax` (pays back sales tax), `late_delivery_shipping` (the compensation owed because a guaranteed delivery arrived later than its promised date) |
| `amount` | the refund amount in USD | a positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent; booked exactly as given |

**Return.** A receipt with: `status` the literal "refunded" when the refund entry was recorded; `order_event_id` the reference of the refund entry; `order_id` the order refunded; `return_id` the return the refund settles; `refund_component` the component recorded; `amount` the USD amount refunded with 2 decimal places; `funded_by` the literal "northloop"; `net_paid_amount` the order's net amount paid including this refund, USD with 2 decimal places; `event_date` the refund date as YYYY-MM-DD.
